title: The Works: grade 4 belts and gatherers
lines: Grade 4 belts carry 600 items a minute. Research them in tier 7.
Grade 4 gatherers work 2.5 times as fast as grade 1.

more.head: Lines
points: Tunnels, splitters, joiners and sorters get grade 4 too. Each carries 600 items a minute.
That is twice grade 3. A line still runs at the pace of its slowest piece.
Fourth-grade lines costs 20,000 Star folios. It needs The Star folio first.
A grade 4 piece costs 40 times grade 1. A belt tile costs 40 Coins.

more.head: Gatherers
points: Fourth-grade gatherers costs 10,000 Star folios. It needs The Star folio first.
A grade 4 gatherer gathers 1 star crystal a minute. It costs 200 Coins and draws 3 power.

more.head: How it looks
points: Grade 4 lines are dark iron with a lilac light. Grade 4 gatherers wear an iron hat and push an iron cart.
Grade 4 pieces have 3 brass studs in the corner.
